data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 15,950 6,860 9,090
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased from $43.851m at 1 January 2016 to $52.895m at 31 December 2016. The report shows gross prior-year adverse development of $15.95m (approximately 36.4% of opening gross reserves), recorded in the claims movements reconciliation. The managing agent attributes reserving uncertainty to complex claims, late notifications and potential development on prior losses; no specific named catastrophe events are quantified as driving the movement in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims which are of a complex nature, particularly where information is not forthcoming or have the potential to develop further in the light of litigation or legal dispute;
Future advices/notifications particularly with respect to significant losses occurring close to the year end.
IBNR for major catastrophe losses is individually assessed by underwriting and non- underwriting management.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount taken from the Claims Outstanding reconciliation (Note 12) line 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' (gross $15,950k). This has been interpreted as the gross prior-year development per the movement note. All monetary figures are reported in the native currency of the accounts (US Dollars) and converted from the reported $'000 into millions. No explicit narrative sentence quantifying the gross prior-year movement was found apart from the reconciliation table. A loss-ratio development table (percent) is provided in the notes but no absolute gross claims development triangle in monetary units was present.
